verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack mentions Pulumi's targeting/exclusion flags (e.g., `--target`, `--exclude`) for `pulumi preview`/`pulumi up`/`pulumi destroy`; the pack only covers preview mechanics, import, and state/backends without addressing resource-scoped plan/apply. missing for 10: documentation or hands-on proof of --target/--exclude (or equivalent) flags limiting a plan/apply to specific resources.
